_comment: Seed data only. Loaded by `manage.py seed_reference`; migration reference.0007 applies data/thana_mapping.csv to existing databases. After seeding, region assignment is managed in the database via the admin dashboard; re-running the seed never overwrites dashboard edits unless --reset-region-assignments is passed. Districts and thanas: BANBEIS institution list, e-survey 2024 (three district typos fixed: Brahmanbaria, Cox's Bazar, Chapainawabganj), plus the upazilas created after that survey, the cantonments (group = Cantonment) and one "Other thana (not listed)" per district (group = Other). Bangla names carried over from the previous upazila list where the place matches. Built by scripts/build_thana_seed.py.
